versions.changelog:
Initial release of the degree certificate OCR skill.

- Supports recognition of degree certificates, extracting recipient name, degree type, granting institution, and date.
- Structured JSON output with recognition results and confidence score.
- Requires SCNET_API_KEY for authentication; supports optional SCNET_API_BASE configuration.
- Simple CLI invocation and AI dialogue integration.
- Includes rate limit handling (10 QPS) and user guidance for configuration and troubleshooting.
